raw_answer: Option C: first increases and then decreases
reasoning_steps: Angular momentum L = I omega is conserved since there is no external torque.
When the insect moves from rim to centre, the moment of inertia I decreases.
Since L is constant, the angular speed omega increases.
When the insect moves from the centre to the opposite rim, I increases.
This causes the angular speed omega to decrease.
Therefore, the angular speed first increases and then decreases.
assumptions_used: No external torque on the system
